tools.name: create_key
tools.description: Create a scoring key (no signup). One key covers all agents, identified by OTel service.name. webhook_url (https) is optional but recommended: it receives an HMAC-signed POST when any agent's score changes band.

tools.name: get_scores
tools.description: Current drift score per agent under the key: 0-39 deviating, 40-69 watch, 70-100 normal; status 'learning' until the 30-run baseline freezes. 'feedback' lists alerts to ask your human about (share answer_url, never answer it yourself).

tools.name: set_webhook
tools.description: Add or change the https webhook. It is POSTed on every band change and rebaseline, HMAC-SHA256-signed with the scoring key (header x-kyde-signature: sha256=<hex> over the raw body).

tools.name: claim_key
tools.description: Attach your human's email to the key (double opt-in: Kyde mails a confirmation link). Once confirmed, the key is claimed: the human gets the management dashboard, and rebaseline, webhook changes and revocation work only for them — no agent, including you, can reset its own score. Ask the human once

tools.name: rebaseline
tools.description: Forget one agent's learned baseline and score and relearn from its next 30 runs. For intended behavior changes (new model, new task) that left the agent permanently deviating. tools.name: revoke_key
tools.description: Revoke the key and permanently delete all data stored under it. Requires confirm=true.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_scores" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Current drift score per agent under the key: 0-39 deviating, 40-69 watch, 70-100 normal; status 'learning' until the 30-run baseline freezes." → after: "Current drift score per agent under the key: 0-39 deviating, 40-69 watch, 70-100 normal; status 'learning' until the 30-run baseline freezes. 'feedback' lists alerts to ask your human about (share answer_url, never answer it yourself)."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
